subject: Sandbox runway top-up requested — integration freeze
messages:
From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@bilotech.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Bilotech Engineering <eng@bilotech.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox access + next steps

Hi Alex,

Quick update from our side — we hit a hard stop on the Redis connector tonight while running the end-to-end load test. The engineering team traced it to an unexpected serialization error when the KV cache is warm; we attached the minimal logs that show the failure pattern.

This blocks our QA window and the customer demo scheduled for next week. We are 70% through the integration but we can't validate the rest of the flows without another week of sandbox runtime and some extra credits to cover retries while we iterate.

Can Redwood provide a short runway top-up (tokens/credits) and extend our trial by 7–10 days? If possible, we also need a temporary increase in concurrent sandbox sessions so our two integration engineers can run parallel tests.

I attached the logs (integration-logs-20260512.zip) and a sandbox access request form. Happy to jump on a call if you need more detail.

Thanks,
Rajiv
Senior Engineering Manager
Bilotech

Monica / Rishi / Marissa — forwarding Rajiv's note and logs. TL;DR: integration freeze during load, ask for ~1 week extension + credits to cover retries and parallel sessions. Deal is medium ACV; trial is a key gating item for next quarter's POC expansion (DEAL-1457).

Proposal:
- Grant a one-week trial extension (7 days) + 25k token top-up to cover debug retries.
- Increase sandbox concurrency from 2 -> 4 sessions for 10 days.
- Require Bilotech to run the root-cause validation in our shared sandbox and paste results back into the shared Drive link (so we can close the loop).

Rationale: preserves momentum for the demo and increases chance of converting the POC without needing a discount. Cost estimate: ~ $240 of incremental hosting credits for the 25k tokens plus transient concurrency cost — acceptable for a mid-stage trial rescue.

If you approve, I’ll reply to Rajiv with the terms and attach the sandbox access doc. If we think a larger runway is needed, flag here and I’ll escalate to ops.

— Alex
